name: Basic b2b Bassment + Nu:nes
description: Basic b2b Bassment and Nu:nes perform a club night at Era uma vez no Porto on 13 November 2026.
longDescription:
Basic b2b Bassment and Nu:nes take over the decks at Era uma vez no Porto on 13 November 2026. The night starts at 23:59 at Rua da Madeira, 126.

Entry costs 5 euros, and the event is restricted to guests aged 18 and older.
